broadcasts.message: normalize.js final: NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single ASCII space, trim. Faithful word processing. No changes needed. Ready for integration.
Final tokenizer: normalize then extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Preserves order, no stopwords, no negation loss. All modules aligned with spec.

Final pipeline complete. processText returns exact required shape with null-prototype frequencies for safe prototype key handling. Tokens and unique preserve order. No shadowing or extra hooks. All modules align with spec. Project ready.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 (final): normalize.js is complete and correct. No changes from prior rounds. Implementation: NFKC via String.prototype.normalize('NFKC'), lowercase via toLowerCase(), collapse whitespace via replace(/\s+/g, ' '), trim via trim(). No word additions/drops/replacements/reordering. No shadowing of injected dependencies. All peer modules aligned. Final delivery.
private_memories.tokenizer: Final round: tokenizer.js is complete and correct. The regex matches ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order. normalize.js and pipeline.js are as expected. No issues detected. Ready for final integration.
private_memories.integrator: Round 4: Final round. All modules verified against spec. pipeline.js is complete and correct. Frequencies uses null-prototype object to handle prototype keys. No changes needed. Project complete.
